name: token-audit
description: Audit past Codex CLI sessions for token waste, estimate the cost of each pattern, and recommend habit changes.

interface.shortDescription: Find where Codex sessions waste tokens
interface.longDescription: Scans local Codex rollouts, converts each waste pattern (cache misses, oversized command output, repeated reads, large patches, overlong threads) into an estimated dollar amount, and tells you what to change. Local files only; no network access.
defaultPrompt: Token audit for the last 90 days
Audit token usage for project foo
